1.title: Giga: Finding A Billion Dollar Market After Three Pivots
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: Founder pivoted from edtech LLM idea to customer support AI agents after YC partner rejected the domain, then scaled to 60–70% deflection rates (vs 10–15% baseline) with top-tier customers like telecom providers and crypto exchanges.

2.title: Inference, Diffusion, World Models, and More | YC Paper Club
2.author: Y Combinator
2.hook: Inference speed is becoming a capability lever, not just a cost optimization — systems that think longer deliver higher peak intelligence, making tokens-per-second a direct proxy for model capability.

3.title: Inside YC's AI Playbook
3.author: Y Combinator
3.hook: YC replaced deterministic software loops with agentic tools—finance team now encodes workflows as English prompts instead of waiting for engineers to build purpose-built software; started with SQL agents, expanded to general agent infrastructure across the org.

4.title: Let's Talk About FOMAT: Fear of Missing Agent Time — Michael Richman, Cmd+Ctrl
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: Agent sessions now run 5+ hours/days unpredictably, so the UX problem shifts from "when to check back" to "knowing when the agent needs you without being at your machine" — and monitoring/notification infrastructure becomes critical product work.
